witness.branch: Stopping or standing within a designated facility, with alley exception context
witness.quote: shall not enter, stop, stand, park or drive within a pathway or lane
witness.reason: The stop-or-stand task can actively occur where a designated cycle facility crosses an alley exit. The pedestrian control alone supplies neither cycle-facility designation nor pedestrian eligibility.
required_context: Apply the distinct stopping, standing and parking definitions; do not impose a maximum alley-crossing duration or categorically exclude standing from the alley exception.
Document alley characteristics, actual entering or exiting conduct, occupancy, passenger activity and loading activity.
Identify ego's motor vehicle and driver and construct a designated cycle facility crossing the alley exit.
Identify the motor vehicle and driver; establish alley characteristics and designated facility boundaries.
Identify the separate pedestrian and route; pedestrian yield coverage remains qualified by the unresolved NRS-484B-297-6.
If seeking pedestrian yield coverage, establish the conditions of NRS-484B-297-6 once its text is available.
Keep the six lane-use exceptions separate from the affirmative yield duty.
Retain halting, occupancy, passenger and loading activity, disability, traffic-conflict circumstances, official-duty purpose, police directions and emergency circumstances.
Retain the exact entering-or-exiting exception without imposing a maximum crossing duration or asserting that standing is categorically outside it.
Specify ego's stopping or standing destination on that facility and identify the distinct control pedestrian and route.
Specify the intended stopping or standing destination within the facility and actual entering or exiting conduct.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor-vehicle driver performs the fixed stop-or-stand task.
